## Differential and Diagnostic Species Classification

`vpro_diagnostics()` reproduces both legacy `V7mdlDiagnostic` crosstab rules (`d`, `dd`, `cd`, `c`, `ic`) and refined BEC differential tiers (`d1`--`d3`, `dd1`--`dd4`), alongside Roman-numeral presence (`I`--`V`), Domin-Krajina significance (`+`, `1`--`9`), Prominence, and Goldstream scores:

```{r}
library(vpro)

ws <- vpro_connect("Sample")
diag_res <- vpro_diagnostics(ws, lump = TRUE, exclude_modifiers = TRUE, min_constancy = 40)
head(diag_res$crosstab, 10)
```

## Pairwise Unit Similarity and Misplaced-Plot Outlier Review

`vpro_pairwise()` implements the Ministry diagnostic-potential pairwise similarity algorithm (`_do_pairwise.R`), quantifying shared diagnostic potential versus differential separation between every pair of site units:

```{r}
pw <- vpro_pairwise(ws, min_plots = 3, min_constancy = 50)
head(pw$pairs)
```

`vpro_outliers()` computes Leave-One-Out (LOO) unit-centroid similarity per plot and flags plots that sit closer to a rival unit centroid (`margin < 0`):

```{r}
out_q <- vpro_outliers(ws, threshold = 0.45)
head(tibble::as_tibble(out_q), 8)
```

## Set-Algebra Plot Profiling (`Add`, `Common`, `Subtract`)

`vpro_profile()` evaluates either stored `*_Profile` tables in a VPro database or tidy R `vpro_profile_rule()` pipelines with step-by-step plot retention counts:

```{r}
prof_stored <- vpro_profile(ws, profile_table = "Sample_Profile")
prof_stored$steps[, c("step", "operation", "description", "matched_n", "retained_n")]

rules <- list(
  vpro_profile_rule("Env", field = "Elevation", operator = ">=", value = 800, operation = "Add"),
  vpro_profile_rule("Veg", species = "ABIELAS", layer = "A", operator = ">=", value = 5, operation = "Common")
)
prof_custom <- vpro_profile(ws, rules = rules)
prof_custom$steps
```

## Hierarchy Breakpoints (`~`) and Synthesis Publication

Both `vpro_summary_veg()` and `vpro_summary_env()` support dynamic `~` tilde breakpoint rollups from `<Name>_Hierarchy`, and export directly to multi-sheet `.xlsx` workbooks via `vpro_export_xlsx()`:

```{r}
veg_sum <- vpro_summary_veg(ws, group_by = "strata", min_constancy = 40)
env_sum <- vpro_summary_env(ws)
head(env_sum[, c("SiteUnit", "n_plots", "elevation_mean", "smr_modal", "snr_modal")])
```
